title: Chapter 420 - 420 Answer; Work Hard!

Chapter 420 - 420 Answer; Work Hard!

Chapter 420 - 420 Answer; Work Hard!

420 Answer; Work Hard!

Hao Zhiwu opened his mouth but did not know what to say.

In the past, as long as he waved at Lil White, it would come over very quickly.

However, this time…

Hao Zhiwu’s hand was about to break, but Lil White was still by Lin Fan’s feet. It kept rubbing against Lin Fan’s feet and making sounds to please him.

Hao Zhiwu was a little helpless. He walked in front of Lin Fan and said, “Lil White, Professor Lin has a lot of important things to deal with. Don’t disturb him.”

As he spoke, Hao Zhiwu reached out to carry the cat.

However, Lil White’s body swayed, and it dodged to the side.

Then, it jumped into Lin Fan’s arms.

Seeing this…

Liu Qianqian, Jiang Chaoqun, and the others revealed a strange look again.

It was as if they were saying, ‘Is this what you mean by very clingy?’

Hao Zhiwu’s face was filled with embarrassment.

After a while, he asked, “Professor Lin, where did you buy the cat food?”

Obviously, he also realized that his cat liked this cat food very much.

That was why he turned a blind eye to his summoning.

“I bought it from Premium Supermarket,” Lin Fan said.

Hao Zhiwu’s eyebrows twitched slightly.

He had only been in Jiangbei for a few days.

However, he had also heard of the name Premium Supermarket.

It was synonymous with Jiangbei’s luxury and fresh food!

“This… How much is this bag of cat food?” Hao Zhiwu asked carefully.

“I think it only costs a little over 1,000 yuan,” Lin Fan said.

It only cost a little over 1,000 yuan!

The corners of everyone’s mouths twitched.

One had to know…

The bag of cat food in Lin Fan’s hand was only the size of a palm.

It was so mall…

Yet it cost more than 1,000 yuan?

Was there gold in this bag of cat food?

Originally…

Hao Zhiwu was still thinking about giving Lil White this cat food every day when he got back.

In this way, Lil White would only stick to him in the future.

At this moment, he completely threw this thought to the back of his mind.

Eating this kind of cat food every day?

It would be a big loss.

Hao Zhiwu looked at Lil White, who was lying in Lin Fan’s arms and purring. In the end, he could only turn around.

Thus, Hao Zhiwu, Nie Zhenjiang, Liu Qianqian, Jiang Chaoqun, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, and the others began today’s study time again.

The tips of the pens collided with the tables, making crisp sounds again.

Maybe…

Just as Hao Zhiwu had said, when he was with Lil White, his learning efficiency increased.

Two hours later, Hao Zhiwu came to Lin Fan excitedly with a large stack of draft paper.

“Professor Lin, look… How did I answer this problem?”

Nie Zhenjiang, Liu Qianqian, Jiang Chaoqun, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, and the others all felt their hearts tighten.

Lin Fan had given everyone some problems.

However, these problems were all very complicated.

Many of them had just begun to think.

In the end, Hao Zhiwu answered one of them so quickly?

Lin Fan took the draft paper from Hao Zhiwu and flipped through it quickly.

“Professor Lin, the questions you set are really good!” Hao Zhiwu said.

“The kidney is the biggest treasure trove of the human body.

“Once it’s infected, the patient will be sluggish.

“Through your questions and my answers, we can make large progress in this field of study!

“Professor Lin, your understanding of the kidney is simply the essence!

“This treasure trove must be…”

At this moment, Lin Fan interrupted, “According to your explanation, the kidney that’s originally exhausted will soon become swollen.”

“What? Edema?” Hao Zhiwu was stunned for a moment.

Lin Fan said, “Think again.”

Hao Zhiwu frowned.

After a long while, he finally understood. He hurriedly turned around and sat down. Then, he picked up his pen and wrote quickly.

This time, Hao Zhiwu did not even raise his head.

After an hour, he took a stack of draft papers and came to Lin Fan.

Lin Fan nodded in satisfaction. “Not bad this time!””

Hao Zhiwu’s face lit up when he heard that. He said proudly, “Professor Lin, didn’t I say that I’d be much more efficient with Lil White?”

It had to be said that Hao Zhiwu’s mentality was really good.

Or rather, the more he was defeated, the braver he became.

He directly threw his previous mistake to the back of his mind.

As for what it meant to be more efficient by being around Lil White… it was all nonsense.

In fact…

After three days of research, Hao Zhiwu had almost finished one of the problems yesterday.

It was just that he encountered some problems along the way.

However, he could have made the changes in time.

While Hao Zhiwu was talking, a round white cat was lying beside Lin Fan and purring.

Hao Zhiwu’s expression immediately froze.

Great!

Pretend he did not say anything!

This cat had nothing to do with his learning efficiency!

Nie Zhenjiang, Liu Qianqian, Jiang Chaoqun, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, and the others, who were also sitting in the office, all cast envious gazes at Hao Zhiwu.

He had answered one of the problems!

Hao Zhiwu was the first to answer one of Lin Fan’s problems!

However, the crowd was not depressed because they were lagging behind.

On the contrary, they gripped their pens and paper tightly. They were filled with fighting spirit as they solved the difficult problems in front of them.

Especially Xia Bing and Xia Xue. Their two quiet little faces seemed to have a phrase written on them—’Competition is the greatest motivation for mankind to move forward!’

A few days ago, everyone would choose to rest for an hour after lunch.

However, this afternoon, Nie Zhenjiang, Liu Qianqian, Jiang Chaoqun, Xia Bing, and Xia Xue did not take a break.

After Xia Bing and Xia Xue bought two pieces of bread from the small supermarket nearby, they continued to crack the program while eating the bread.

In their hearts, they were telling themselves that they had already lost to one person in front of Lin Fan. They definitely could not lose to a second person!

Absolutely not!

Xia Bing and Xia Xue’s beautiful eyes stared at the screen full of complicated codes without blinking. Their two jade-like hands jumped on the keyboard like phantoms.

At this moment, the laptops in front of them let out a soft sound.

Immediately after, a line of words appeared on the screens.

Right at this moment…

“Professor Lin, what do you think of my answer to this question?” Jiang Chaoqun stood up and asked.

Lin Fan did not answer him immediately. Instead, he looked at Xia Bing’s and Xia Xue’s screens as he said, “Xia Bing, Xia Xue, you two did well!

“This program has a total of three stages. Passing one stage means that you’ve solved a difficult problem.”

When Xia Bing and Xia Xue heard this, it was as if they had heard the most beautiful sound in the world. Their beautiful faces were immediately like blooming flowers, extremely brilliant!
